findings.obs_text: In Gen 32:20 Jacob thinks to appease Esau with the present sent ahead: the gift is the means the thought plans. In Rut 4:4 Boaz thought to put the offer before the elders, in Jer 40:5 Jeremiah is given a present and told to go where he thinks right, and in 1Cor 7:26 Paul judges in view of the present distress.
findings.grounds: I may appease him with the present that goes ahead of me

findings.obs_text: In Num 5:28 the woman found clean shall be free and conceive children: conceive is bodily, and free names her release from the curse; no thought is in view.
findings.grounds: she shall be free and shall conceive children

findings.obs_text: In 2Ki 7:12 the king thinks the Syrians know the people are hungry and lie in wait: the hunger is the ground of the enemy's supposed plan. In Luk 13:2 the hearers are asked whether they think those who suffered were worse sinners, and in 1Pe 4:1 Christ's suffering in the flesh is the way of thinking to arm oneself with.
findings.grounds: Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners

findings.obs_text: In Eze 38:10 thoughts come into Gog's mind and he devises an evil scheme: the thoughts arise first and the scheme follows from them.
findings.grounds: you will devise an evil scheme

older.finding: Devise names the inner operation of planning, scheming or designing: evil devised in the heart, good devised, and the skill given to devise designs.
older.reason: it states how plot works in a person; the plot collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Job 32:6, Job 32:10 and Job 32:17 Elihu holds back and then declares his opinion: the view is spoken out. In Psa 40:5 the psalmist would proclaim the Lord's thoughts, in Isa 55:8 the Lord declares his thoughts are not theirs, and in Amo 4:13 he declares to man what is his thought. In Dan 5:10 the queen speaks to the king whose thoughts alarm him, and in Phili 1:17 some proclaim Christ thinking to afflict Paul.
findings.grounds: declares to man what is his thought

findings.obs_text: In Lam 1:9 Jerusalem took no thought of her future, and the enemy has triumphed: the lack of thought ends in the enemy's victory.
findings.grounds: she took no thought of her future
